hypotheses.paper: lambda absolutely continuous w.r.t. Lebesgue (main.tex:731) / the Riemannian volume (main.tex:217)
hypotheses.note: (Phi_i)_# lambda << lambda for each i (nonsingular moves), the corrected form of record of C-6/C-7 (DEC-141); inflow_ac_iff is the sharp criterion; bind_ac_iff_map_ac shows the hypothesis is necessary when the weights are positive; not_map_ac_acMap shows it is exactly what fails in the strict counterexample EGF.printed_inflow_not_ac

measurable maps, no inverse, no Jacobian (IsEGFPolicy); homeomorphisms in InflowAC.of_isEGF, with no BorelSpace hypothesis; measurable bijections only where the printed formula needs Phi_i^{-1} (backward_policy_measurePreserving)
F_out << lambda; any measure for the << statements, a finite one for the density statement inflow_eq_withDensity_sum_rnDeriv

in backward_policy_measurePreserving the factor is 1: Phi_i measure-preserving; rnDeriv_map_ae_eq_one (lambda-Jacobian) and coordJac_ae_eq_one (coordinate Jacobian, Haar measure) show it is 1 a.e. in both readings
not assumed: EGF.backward_policy needs only Phi_i_# lambda = J_i lambda, here with J = 1

findings: main.tex:196 presupposes f_in* = dF_in*/d lambda = d(F_out* pi*)/d lambda. For every EGF policy (main.tex:219) with measurable moves that are nonsingular, (Phi_i)_# lambda << lambda, and every F_out << lambda, F_in = sum_i (Phi_i)_#(alpha^i F_out) << lambda, on any measurable space, with no inverse, no Jacobian and no sigma-finiteness (EGF.IsEGFPolicy.bind_eq_sum_map, EGF.inflow_ac_of_map_ac, EGF.InflowAC.of_map_ac). This proves the corrected text of C-6 (the author's 'straightforward consequence of the diffeomorphism decomposition of the policy').

The criterion is sharp: F_in << lambda iff (Phi_i)_#(alpha^i F_out) << lambda for every i (EGF.inflow_ac_iff); and for positive weights (e.g. the uniform policy) lambda pi << lambda iff every move is nonsingular (EGF.bind_ac_iff_map_ac), so nonsingularity is necessary; a condition on lambda suffices only if it implies it, which the printed lambda << Lebesgue does not (EGF.not_map_ac_acMap) [reworded by the master at graduation, AUDIT-1]. The strict counterexample to the appendix setting (main.tex:731-732, EGF.printed_inflow_not_ac) satisfies every hypothesis of EGF.inflow_ac_of_map_ac but nonsingularity (EGF.not_map_ac_acMap).

Existence of f_in does not need invertible moves, only the closed form of main.tex:737 does: for measurable, possibly non-invertible moves f_in = sum_i d((Phi_i)_#(alpha^i F_out))/d lambda (EGF.inflow_eq_withDensity_sum_rnDeriv; sigma-finite lambda, finite F_out). Example: the doubling map y -> 2y of the circle, measure-preserving and not injective (EGF.doubling_witness), to which EGF.backward_policy does not apply.

For measure-preserving moves the printed formula of main.tex:735-737 holds verbatim with |J_s Phi_i^{-1}| = 1: f_in = sum_i (alpha^i f_out) o Phi_i^{-1} and beta^i = (alpha^i f_out) o Phi_i^{-1} / f_in, on any measurable space, no sigma-finiteness (EGF.backward_policy_measurePreserving, EGF.inflow_eq_withDensity_measurePreserving); both the lambda-Jacobian and, for Haar measure, the coordinate Jacobian are 1 a.e. (EGF.rnDeriv_map_ae_eq_one, EGF.coordJac_ae_eq_one). Every experiment of the paper uses such moves (main.tex:440: translations and SL_2(Z) elements of T^2; main.tex:496: rotations of S^2; the families of main.tex:284 and :303), so the discrepancy of C-8 (coordinate versus lambda-Jacobian) does not touch them. The measure-preservation of affine SL_d(Z) maps of tori and of rotations of spheres is checked by hand here and is T-egf-families's / T-egf-families-sphere's to formalize.

corrections.notes: Proved, sorry-free, in the corrected text's form: F_out pi = sum_i (Phi_i)_#(alpha^i F_out) << lambda as soon as (Phi_i)_# lambda << lambda for every i and F_out << lambda; measurable Phi_i, no inverse, no Jacobian, no sigma-finiteness, any measurable space. The listed anchor EGF.inflowAC_of_isEGFPolicy (narrower) can be switched: EGF.InflowAC.of_map_eq_withDensity derives its conclusion from its hypotheses minus the measurability of J and f_out. Corollary 3.10 without InflowAC (EGF.pinsker_negative_control_nonsingular) is T-egf-loss's, not done here.

Supports the corrected setting (moves nonsingular for lambda): it is exactly the hypothesis the refutation EGF.printed_inflow_not_ac violates (not_map_ac_acMap), it is necessary for positive weights (bind_ac_iff_map_ac), and it holds for measure-preserving moves and for Haar measure with C^n diffeomorphisms (n >= 1) or any measurable map with a differentiable left inverse (no Jacobian formula used). It is Mathlib's Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving.

Supports: for measure-preserving moves the lambda-Jacobian and the coordinate Jacobian (Haar measure) are both 1 a.e., and the printed formula holds verbatim with |J| = 1, without sigma-finiteness; the setting of every experiment of the paper.

kb_proposals: F_in << lambda for an EGF needs only nonsingular moves: EGF.InflowAC.of_map_ac (any measurable space, measurable Phi_i, no inverse, no sigma-finiteness); for measure-preserving moves (tori, spheres) use EGF.map_ac_of_measurePreserving or EGF.InflowAC.of_measurePreserving, and EGF.backward_policy_measurePreserving for the backward policy with J = 1.

Phi_# mu << mu for Haar mu needs no Jacobian formula: if g o Phi = id with g differentiable, Phi^{-1}(A) is contained in g(A) and addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero gives the null set (EGF.map_ac_of_leftInverse).
Pitfall: measure_mono_null (fun x hx => <y, hy, h>) fails with 'expected type could not be determined'; write the inclusion with show A ⊆ B from fun x hx => ...
notes: Typechecked with lake env lean (no error, no warning) and built once with taskset -c 0-11 lake build EGFScaffold.InflowNonsingular (only this module compiled; no EGF.* or mathlib rebuild). The file is not imported by scaffold/EGFScaffold.lean (not mine to edit): the master adds it at graduation, else the axiom sweep misses it (lean-causal kb 0025). Deviations from the target block, all in the direction of fewer hypotheses: (i) item (4)'s 'sigma-finite lambda' is dropped; (ii) EGF.map_ac_of_differentiable is proved through EGF.map_ac_of_leftInverse (image of null sets under a differentiable map), not through EGF.map_eq_withDensity_abs_det; (iii) InflowAC.of_isEGF takes no BorelSpace (the moves' measurability is part of IsEGFPolicy). No ** mark: theo:backward_policy is already marked in EGF/BackwardPolicy.lean in its corrected form of record; this file is the label's supplement, reported 'partial' because its backward-policy formula assumes measure-preserving moves.
